p0.descriptionHtml:
The Elite Horizontal Panel Headboard brings a calm, balanced look to the wall behind your bed. Wide horizontal panels sit on a padded surface and a wooden frame, and it is handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Wide horizontal panel design
  • Padded surface on a wooden frame
  • Wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base
  • Five UK sizes, made-to-measure on request

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £181.99; Small Double (4FT) £207.99; Double (4FT6) £220.99; King (5FT) £259.99; Super King (6FT) £298.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Padded upholstery on a wooden frame, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The product photos show a soft cream fabric; other fabrics and colours are available from our range and made-to-measure options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Fitting

This listing is for the headboard only. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base, so it works with a divan base you already own. Need help with fitting? Call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every headboard has a 5-year warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between the Elite and the Slim Horizontal headboard?

The Elite uses wide horizontal panels, while the Slim Horizontal Panel Headboard has slimmer panels and a lower profile.

Is this headboard sold with a bed?

No. It is a headboard on its own; fix it to a divan base or wall-mount it.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Related: headboards, Padded Horizontal Channel Headboard.

p1.descriptionHtml:

Key features

  • Contemporary winged upholstered headboard
  • Premium padded fabric upholstery
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Available in all five UK bed sizes
  • Free fabric swatches before you buy

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £350.99; Small Double (4FT) £363.99; Double (4FT6) £376.99; King (5FT) £415.99; Super King (6FT) £506.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the Memory Foam Mattress.

You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Will the Eric Wingback suit a modern bedroom?

Yes. It is our contemporary take on the wingback, with clean proportions designed for modern interiors.

Where is the Eric Wingback Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.

Key features

  • Wooden frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation

Sizes and prices

Listed at £309.00. Available in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Please call 07417 439197 to confirm the price for your size before ordering. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

The Essential is our simplest Chesterfield, with no wingback and no gold trim.
